data.standardized_narrative: The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 was GBP 104.513m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle for prior underwriting years (2015 and 2016) shows no material net change in the cumulative estimates, resulting in no net prior-year development for the period. The syndicate reports adverse impacts in 2017 from hurricane events (Harvey, Irma, Maria and the Mexican earthquake) and has recognised additional run-off related provisions (notably a GBP 2.5m provision in respect of anticipated run-off costs related to a future third-party RITC transaction), but these items did not produce a net prior-year reserve movement across the older years when measured on the gross triangle basis.

lower than originally anticipated gross premium exposure leading to reductions in anticipated reinsurance recoveries and expected underwriting profit.
net technical result, loss of GBP 18.6m includes an additional technical provision of GBP 2.5m in respect of anticipated run-off costs for a future third-party RITC transaction

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' note was found. Prior-year development was derived from the gross claims development triangle (pages 29), which shows no change for underwriting years 2015 and 2016 (net PYD = 0). The syndicate references RITC and run-off related provisions (including an explicit GBP 2.5m provision) which may distort comparability; triangle was used as primary gross source.
